cases.name: Kristi Joy Gardner
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Kristi grew up in Rake, Iowa where she enjoyed playing volleyball, basketball, excelled at shot put in track in field, playing flute in the school marching band, and was a majorette. 

Kristi graduated from Lake Crystal High School in 1986. She then graduated from South Central Vo-Tech with her LPN degree. Kristi was a nurse at the Mankato Clinic for 26 ½ years, where she devoted herself to her patients.

Kristi’s greatest joy in life were her children and grandchildren. She loved watching TV dramas, playing Candy Crush, thrift store shopping, finding a deal, being organized, keeping things clean, puzzles, and gardening. She loved cooking and baking “Norwegian” dishes and showing her love to others by sharing what she cooked."
